observations.title: Keep startup registration in its native lifecycle
observations.player_action: Author item and block registration handlers in the pack's startup script tree.
observations.outcome: Startup registrations run at game startup and generally require a restart after identity changes; a server data reload is not equivalent to rebuilding registries.
conditions: Research only: no script, registry or running game was changed.
Author documentation can cover newer releases; installed version is 2001.6.5-build.26.

observations.title: Use server data events for recipes and tags
observations.player_action: Author a recipe or tag handler in server scripts and review the owning data event.
observations.outcome: Reloadable recipe and tag modifications belong to server/data events, while some other changes still require a world or game restart.
conditions: The exact installed API/event signature and project Atlas change record are required before implementing a rule.

observations.title: Separate client presentation from server rules
observations.player_action: Keep client-specific presentation handlers in client scripts and gameplay validation on the server.
observations.outcome: The script directory/lifecycle boundary prevents client rendering work from being treated as authoritative world state.
conditions: Client-only imports are not valid in a dedicated server script.
